scenarios.prompt: A SaaS company spent $240,000 on marketing + sales last quarter and acquired 1,200 new customers. ARPU = $85/month, gross margin = 68%, monthly churn = 4%. Give me CAC, LTV, LTV/CAC ratio, and CAC payback period in months. Report as cac, ltv, ltv_cac_ratio, payback_months.

A subscription business reports: marketing + sales spend $500,000, new customers acquired 2,000, annual ARPU $1,200, gross margin 75%, monthly churn 5%. Compute cac, ltv, ltv_cac_ratio, payback_months.
Marketing spend $90,000, 600 new customers, monthly ARPU $50, gross margin 40%, monthly churn 8%. Report cac, ltv, ltv_cac_ratio, payback_months.
